d: The Fit-Out Project Manager is responsible for managing fit-out and construction projects from planning through completion, ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and according to approved drawings, specifications, and quality standards.
Manage daily fit-out and construction activities .
Plan and monitor project schedules, progress, and resources .
Coordinate with clients, consultants, contractors, and subcontractors.
Review drawings, specifications, shop drawings, and technical submissions.
Monitor finishing works and ensure compliance with approved standards.
Manage variations, claims, delays, and project risks .
Conduct inspections, snagging, and project handover.
Lead project meetings and resolve site/technical issues.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, or related field .
3+ years of experience in construction and fit-out projects.
Experience in finishing and interior fit-out works .
Proficiency in Primavera P6 / MS Project, AutoCAD, and Microsoft Office .
Strong coordination, leadership, and communication skills.
Good command of English and Arabic , written and spoken.
